thread:
Alicia: Heads-up — quick design sync? The invite settings popover + SSO toggle copy are causing confusion in usability testing, and there are a couple of a11y nits. Can we triage before today's review? Ben: I saw this in the test notes. Users think the toggle enforces SSO for the whole org, not just new invites. Can you paste the screenshot? Alicia: Uploaded screenshot to #design-assets: https://redwood-assets/ssotoggle.png — the label reads 'Require SSO for invites' right now. Carla: My quick thoughts: (1) popover CTA contrast is borderline, (2) copy is ambiguous. Suggest: 'Require SSO to accept new invitations' or 'Require SSO for invite acceptance'. Shorter alt: 'Require SSO for invite acceptance'. Darren: Heads-up on backend: the flag is called `sso_enforce_invites` in the DB. Changing UX only is fine, but if we rename metrics we need migration. :grimacing: Ben: We can keep backend key. Front-end change + tooltip explaining scope should fix most confusion. Tooltip idea: 'This affects only invitations sent after turning this on. Existing members are not affected.' Alicia: Also found a11y issue: when opening the popover with NVDA/Chrome the keyboard focus is not trapped — focus goes behind the overlay. Carla, can you propose ARIA improvements? Carla: Yep — make the popover a proper dialog. Minimal patch: add `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby=\"invite-popover-title\"`, trap focus, and ensure the primary CTA has >=4.5:1 contrast. Example snippet: ```
``` Designbot: Uploaded updated mocks (v2): https://redwood-assets/mocks/invite-popover-v2.png — variant B shortens copy and adds a small info icon with tooltip. Evan: Quick product question: for audit logs, would a dedicated filter help CS? e.g., 'Invites (SSO enforced)' so they can see who turned it on and when? Ben: I like a filter but avoid long labels. Proposal: add a filter chip 'Invites — SSO' and show a tooltip 'Invitations sent when SSO enforcement was enabled'. Also add an action column for 'SSO state' to the invite events to aid searching. Alicia: For mobile, popover should fallback to full-screen sheet — current layout clips. Also we should ensure the audit filter is available in the mobile audit view (maybe under advanced filters). Carla: Minor: add a keyboard shortcut to open Invite Settings from the org settings page (or at least document a quick nav). Accessibility tests: add an e2e that tabs into the dialog and verifies `aria-modal` and focus trap. Darren: We'll emit analytics: `invite_popover_open`, `invite_popover_submit`, `sso_toggle_changed` with previous/next state. That should help measure confusion. Alicia: Can someone put up a tiny PR with the copy tweak + ARIA attributes + test plan? Assigning @Ben. Ben: I'll do a PR today — will include: updated copy, tooltip text, `role=\"dialog\"` + focus trap, contrast fix, and an e2e a11y test (NVDA/Chrome smoke). ETA EOD. Designbot: Reminder: design review at 3pm — I'll demo the prototypes and walk through the copy variants live. Alicia: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll sync the test report into the review notes and tag CS for audit filter use cases. :thumbsup:
